title: Post fixed2M learning-method allocation review
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Retained failures and objective contracts distinguish under-scaled alternatives from falsified mechanisms before choosing one learned-weight control.
material_change: Zero-hand review of PPO objective and prior neural-regret evidence; no training restart.
notes: Read-only triage located prior Deep CFR controls and sampled-training versus greedy-evaluation distinction. Neither proves current failure. Initial logger launch rejected before execution; simplified command metadata for retry. No new hands.

Read six prior neural-regret analyses and inspected paper-loss/iteration/reservoir code. Preserved later correction of sequential-update claim; first-iteration zero-weight suspicion disproved. Current snapshot loss is decisive policy-specific evidence, not large-scale algorithm falsification. No new hands or training.

Checked phased PPO response and whole-hand three-teacher fit; not complete NFSP. Training-average gains coexist with four of five negative anchor point effects and three family25 negative intervals. Inspect public value/advantage learning and prior centralized-critic controls before method selection. Zero new hands.

result.summary: Bounded method review completed; selected independent observable-state critic encoder as sole major control.
result.conclusion: Current detached value features impose a testable representation restriction; prior privileged-critic and high-pot results do not establish a causal critic defect or rule out this control.
result.decision: Implement isolated cloned value encoder with initial forward parity and named optimizer preservation before matched two-seed geometric training.
result.next_step: Qualify actual worker and PPO path, retained replay semantics and full checkpoint roundtrip; then preregister matched262k/1M curve.
